tr: "It's Ayse Demir." Soyadı Demir.

tr: "She's studying music in London."
de: Es heißt "She's studying music in London."

tr: "I'm going to study here for six months."
de: Es heißt "I'm going to study here for six months."

tr: "There's a ticket machine near the main door."
de: Es heißt "There's a ticket machine near the main door."

tr: "I live in Milan with my sister" — şehir Milano.
de: "I live in Milan with my sister" — die Stadt ist Mailand.

tr: "It's twenty euros." Fiyatı resepsiyon söylüyor.
de: "It's twenty euros." Den Preis nennt die Rezeption.

tr: "She's nineteen. She's studying music in London."
de: Es heißt "She's nineteen. She's studying music in London."

tr: "stay at home for two days." Yarın işe gidemiyor.
de: "stay at home for two days." Morgen kann sie nicht zur Arbeit.

tr: "Jeans: 30 dollars." Ayakkabı 45, tişört 12 dolar.
de: "Jeans: 30 dollars." Schuhe kosten 45, T-Shirts 12 Dollar.

tr: Küçük beden yok; müşteri "OK, medium is fine" diyor.
de: Die kleine Größe gibt es nicht; die Kundin sagt "OK, medium is fine".

tr: "He is holding our cat, Pamuk." Kediyi Kerem tutuyor.
de: "He is holding our cat, Pamuk." Die Katze hält Kerem.

tr: "He is nine years old." Kerem, Elif'in erkek kardeşi.
de: "He is nine years old." Kerem ist Elifs Bruder.

tr: "Then turn left at the bank." Sağa değil, sola dönülüyor.
de: "Then turn left at the bank." Man biegt nicht rechts, sondern links ab.

tr: "a ticket is fifteen lira" — Emma'nın yirmi lirası yetiyor.
de: "a ticket is fifteen lira" — Emmas zwanzig Lira reichen.

tr: "I walk to school. It is twenty minutes." Otobüse binmiyor.
de: "I walk to school. It is twenty minutes." Sie nimmt keinen Bus.

tr: "Fresh apples ... They're in aisle four, next to the bananas."
de: Es heißt "Fresh apples ... They're in aisle four, next to the bananas."

tr: "Room: 12, second floor" — randevu ikinci kattaki 12 numarada.
de: "Room: 12, second floor" — der Termin ist in Raum 12 im zweiten Stock.

tr: "Here in London I'm living with my aunt." Kardeşleri Türkiye'de.
de: "Here in London I'm living with my aunt." Seine Geschwister sind in der Türkei.

tr: "He has got an exam on Monday." Murat bu yüzden sinemaya gelmiyor.
de: "He has got an exam on Monday." Darum kommt Murat nicht ins Kino.

tr: "Then take the second street on the right. It's called Green Street."
de: Es heißt "Then take the second street on the right. It's called Green Street."

tr: Garson "That's seven dollars fifty" diyor; sandviç ve kahve birlikte.
de: Der Kellner sagt "That's seven dollars fifty"; Sandwich und Kaffee zusammen.

tr: "On Sunday morning I visited the old town with Dad." Anne otelde kaldı.
de: "On Sunday morning I visited the old town with Dad." Die Mutter blieb im Hotel.

tr: "The kitchen bin is full. Please take it out." Listenin ilk maddesi bu.
de: "The kitchen bin is full. Please take it out." Das ist der erste Punkt der Liste.

tr: "Please use the stop in Church Road." Market Street'te yol çalışması var.
de: "Please use the stop in Church Road." In der Market Street wird gebaut.

tr: "Students have got a 10% discount." İndirim için öğrenci kartı gerekiyor.
de: "Students have got a 10% discount." Für den Rabatt braucht man einen Studentenausweis.

tr: "don't bring food. But please bring your camera." Yiyeceği Mert getiriyor.
de: "don't bring food. But please bring your camera." Das Essen bringt Mert mit.

tr: "Mert is a student. Anna works in a hospital." Telefon numarası da Anna'nın.
de: "Mert is a student. Anna works in a hospital." Auch die Telefonnummer gehört Anna.

tr: "It's forty dollars. The green one is thirty dollars." Müşteri siyahı alıyor.
de: "It's forty dollars. The green one is thirty dollars." Die Kundin nimmt die schwarze.

tr: "We have not got Wi-Fi in the garden, but there is Wi-Fi inside." Bahçede yok, içeride var.
de: "We have not got Wi-Fi in the garden, but there is Wi-Fi inside." Im Garten nicht, drinnen schon.

tr: "I speak Italian and Spanish." İngilizceyi henüz öğreniyor, konuştuğu diller arasında saymıyor.
de: "I speak Italian and Spanish." Englisch lernt sie noch und zählt es nicht zu ihren Sprachen.
